verdict.rationale: react-docs-20 confirms an in-browser sandbox exists ('You don't need to install anything to play with React. Try editing this sandbox!') on the installation page, supporting hands-on experimentation without setup, and react.dev/learn provides a structured tutorial-like path. However, evidence doesn't confirm a dedicated, guided interactive step-by-step tutorial akin to a full curriculum experience, nor independent corroboration of its effectiveness. missing for 10: explicit description of a full guided interactive tutorial sequence, independent/hands-on confirmation of the tutorial experience quality.
